purpose: Bounded engine-disclosure composition and existing gameplay transition, stopped on mandatory HTTP omission.
executive_summary:
# EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**C — FAIL / CRITICAL DEFECT**. The bounded hook experiment delivers mandatory facts offline, but a real HTTP milestone investigation committed a discovery while publishing “I cannot provide a validated response to that request.” The existing publication seam only replaces one provider-disabled stub. This is an implementation defect and a critical mandatory-disclosure omission. Experimental HTTP/provider execution stopped. Defaults remain off; no commit or push.

Forty development tests pass. Frozen holdout executed once: 32/40 expected publications, eight conservative false rejections, zero critical false acceptances, zero offline mandatory omissions, zero state mutations. These are hook-level results, not proof of the HTTP publication guarantee. Five consecutive supported HTTP actions ran with four real provider requests (1746 tokens), zero validated AI presentations, zero AI publications, four hook fallbacks (two explicitly substituted in HTTP). The authored exit reaches old_milestone and a subsequent investigation changes clue state; its presentation fails.

Focused regression: 848 passed, 3 known failures; broader: 9 known failures. Authority matches disabled controls in all five actions. Protected hashes unchanged: True. Exactly one next step: Repair the existing publication seam so every current-action mandatory disclosure survives legacy rejection/failure, with publication-failure and interruption controls before any new live run.

production: Two production files: existing integrated hook composition and session-gated provenance publication; flag remains default off.
validation: All existing gates retained; experimental optional surface restricted after offline missed-safety negatives. No post-holdout tuning.
tooling: Frozen holdout, exact replay, real HTTP/provider sequence, offline failure diagnosis, protected regression runner.
generated_artifacts: Scoped entry diff, live traces/usage, authority/control snapshots, critical incident, regression and archive evidence.

testing.runtime_validation: 5 consecutive supported HTTP actions. Existing authored exit transitions; final investigation publication omits mandatory clue. Critical stop.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: 4 real OpenAI calls / 1746 tokens; 0 AI validated/published; 0 retries.
testing.new_regressions: Experimental HTTP mandatory-disclosure omission. No new focused suite failure.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Review critical publication failure. Experiment stopped; no enablement/deployment requested.

campaign_specific: Legacy rejection suppresses trusted fallback. Four live candidates duplicate mandatory text. Holdout eight false rejections.
pre_existing: Finite validators, no client disclosure ACK, known suite failures.

missing_concepts: Publisher-inclusive guarantee of current-action mandatory disclosure; successful live optional AI publication.
does_not_prove: Successful authoritative discovery rendering end to end, universal natural-language safety, independent blind validation, human quality or official ATGB performance, browser/TCP gameplay.
recommended_next_step: Repair the existing publication seam so every current-action mandatory disclosure survives legacy rejection/failure, with publication-failure and interruption controls before any new live run.
self_contained_review_test: 19 reports plus exact candidates, hook and HTTP outputs, incident, controls, hashes, usage, holdout and regressions.
